text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of the New Year's break, 
I went to a shrine famous for health 
prayers, but then—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Put some spirit into it, Trainer! Don't go 
tripping over the vines at your feet!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For certain reasons, I was exploring the 
jungle with Tucker Brine. As for those 
reasons—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh! Praying for the health of your 
trainee, are you?! You were certainly 
praying with great fervor!
choice_data_list:
I just wanted to do everything within my 
power.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Then take me up on my offer! Shall we go 
and claim the legendary fruit together?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Nutrient-packed and fantastic for building 
stamina! Such fruits grow wild across 
Tracen Island.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
With map in hand, let us plunge deep into 
the forest! An out-of-season fruit hunt 
awaits ussss!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Whew…… Quite the trek, isn't it!
choice_data_list: This is nothing…… I can take it……!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's the spirit! Let's keep this 
momentum going!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (HUUUUMMMM...)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hm? That sound is――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: It's a massive swarm of beeees!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Keep your head down... Run, run, ruuun!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*―― I should be 
safe now that I've made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
!! Trainer-san, your feet...! You're stuck 
in the mud!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, overcoming various hurdles 
together, we pressed onward through the 
jungle, but――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Th-The forest is 
clearing up... The fruit tree is just 
ahead...
choice_data_list: Thank goodness... I have no energy left...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Whew…… Ah, but there's still more! I've 
gotta give it my all until the end……!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Wha... To think it was growing wild on a 
cliffside...! ...Quite the treacherous 
climb.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, you stay right here! I'm 
counting on you to watch the bags!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! You're visibly 
running on empty!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're human. Physically 
speaking, that makes this a job for an 
Umamusume like me!!
choice_data_list: I'd love for my trainee to try some too!
I want my students to try it too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: !! Trainer-san……!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Because that's just who 
you are――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you be the base! I'll reach 
out from up there and... snag it!!
choice_data_list: Yes, just what I was hoping for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoisting Tucker Brine onto my shoulders, I 
had her reach out as far as she could 
toward the fruit.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Ngh... All right! Keep up that momentum!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
We've made it this far together! If it's 
the two of us who care so much about the 
Umamusume, we can do this!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This is where we dig deep and hold our 
ground, DAMMIT!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Let's fight! Ohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: I-I caught it... YESSS, WE DID IT~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Well done, well done! Dwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This is nowhere near enough for 
everyone! Let's keep up this momentum and 
harvest like crazy!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Mmmph~~! So sooouuuurr!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, this feels super effective! I'm 
gonna grab one more!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Eat up, eat up! Let's sprint full 
speed ahead through this year with lots of 
energy!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Take a look, Trainer! It's a massive hit!!
choice_data_list: All that hard work was well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This never would have happened without 
you. Thank you so, so much!!
